note: Survey regions are matched to the member territories each framework lists. Where a survey region is wider than the framework area, it is marked partial.

frameworks.name: Cambodia-Laos-Viet Nam Development Triangle Area
frameworks.members: Stung Treng, Ratanakiri, Mondulkiri and Kratie (Cambodia); Sekong, Attapeu, Saravan and Champasak (Lao PDR); Kon Tum, Gia Lai, Dak Lak, Dak Nong and Binh Phuoc (Viet Nam)
frameworks.sourceName: Government of Viet Nam, Government News, CLV Development Triangle Area (9 December 2020)
frameworks.partialNote: Viet Nam's MICS reports the Central Highlands as one region, which contains four of the five Vietnamese provinces in the area plus Lam Dong; Binh Phuoc sits in the Southeast region.

frameworks.name: Brunei Darussalam-Indonesia-Malaysia-Philippines East ASEAN Growth Area
frameworks.members: Brunei Darussalam; the provinces of Kalimantan and Sulawesi, Maluku and Papua (Indonesia); Sabah, Sarawak and Labuan (Malaysia); Mindanao and Palawan (Philippines)
frameworks.partialNote: The Philippine survey reports Mimaropa as one region; only its Palawan province is in the growth area. Brunei Darussalam and the Malaysian states are not covered by the global MPI.
